preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in ['O', 'X'] for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'O' or 'X'.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(grid) <= 100 and all(1 <= len(row) <= 100 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid dimensions are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is within the possible range of X shapes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for row in grid for cell in row if cell == 'X') // len(set(tuple(sorted(tuple(sorted((i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, cell in enumerate(row) if cell == 'X' and (i == 0 or grid[i-1][j] != 'X') and (j == 0 or grid[i][j-1] != 'X')))) for _ in range(len(grid) * len(grid[0]))))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of distinct 'X' shapes in the grid.
